name: Rau rừng
summary: Rau rừng is the island greens, in soup or boiled, with the seafood rice. The Hội An World Heritage centre’s 16 September 2025 study names canh rau and rau luộc in the daily meal. Its 7 July 2014 note names forest greens. The reserve management board, on 3 March 2026, names more than 16 forest leaves and a dip the 2025 study says people now rarely use.
origin: Cham Islands. Forest and garden greens on Tân Hiệp, eaten with the catch.
howToEat: In soup, or boiled, with the midday or evening rice. Lunch is about 11:00–12:00 and the evening meal about 17:00–18:00 on the 16 September 2025 study.

The reserve management board’s 3 March 2026 note names rau dớn, rau sân, rau lủi, and mã đề among more than 16 leaves, boiled and dipped in mắm cái with chili and garlic. The 16 September 2025 study lists mắm cái among foods people no longer or rarely use. Both stay.
A current price is Check on arrival.
where: The hamlets. Neither note names a shop.
seoTitle: Rau rừng — island greens, Cham Islands
seoDescription: Forest greens in soup or boiled, with the seafood rice on Tân Hiệp. One note still dips them in mắm cái. Another says that sauce is now rare. A price is Check on arrival.
